SELECT 
    "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."NCODE", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."DDATE", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."NTIME", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."NFAT", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."NSNF", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."NLTR", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."NRATE", "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."NAMOUNT", "MILK_SUPPLIER"."NCODE", "MILK_SUPPLIER"."VNAME"
FROM
    "BGK"."MILK_INPUT" "MILK_BILL_DETAIL",
    "BGK"."MILK_SUPPLIER" "MILK_SUPPLIER"
WHERE
    "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."NCODE" = "MILK_SUPPLIER"."NCODE" AND
    MILK_BILL_DETAIL."DDATE" >= TO_DATE ('07-NOV-2028 00:00:00', 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AND
    MILK_BILL_DETAIL."DDATE" <= TO_DATE ('07-NOV-2028 23:59:59', 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AND
    "MILK_BILL_DETAIL"."NTIME" = 1.
